name: gear-earbuds-wisp
prompt: The reference image shows a small creature; use it ONLY to judge width. Do NOT draw the creature or any part of it — the image must contain nothing but two earbuds. Draw a pair of wireless earbuds: exactly TWO small rounded pill-shaped earbuds with short stubby stems pointing down, mirror images angled slightly outward, positioned FAR apart with a wide empty gap between them — spaced so they would float just outside the left and right cheeks of the reference creature (a narrow flame body — buds close-set but clearly apart). NO cable, NO wire, NO case, nothing joining them. Sticker-flat cel style, every region ONE perfectly even solid color like a vector illustration — no shading variation, no wash, no mottling — one thick confident uniform rounded outline in a darker warm TAN shade of the cream — the outline is NEVER blue, never black; denim blue appears ONLY as the small accent dot. Colors limited to exactly two: soft warm cream (#f2e9d3) for the earbud bodies, muted denim blue (#47678a) for a small round accent dot on each bud. The pair centered, the gap spanning most of the frame, 10% margin, on a plain solid magenta (#ff00ff) background, no shadow. Negative constraints: no cable, no wire, no cord, no charging case, no third earbud, no narrow gap, no gray, no gradients, no texture, no stipple, no halftone, no watercolor, no 3d render, no clay, no cast shadow, no drop shadow, no background scenery, no character, no head, no ears, no face, no outline sketchiness, no black outline, no text, no watermark, no sticker border, no die-cut white edge.
